title: Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a multi-agent framework and dataset for generating counterspeech against online hate speech. While hate speech targets include religious groups (e.g., Muslims and Jews) and counterspeech strategies occasionally involve moral reframing, the paper's primary objective is mitigating toxicity and evaluating factual/contextual generation rather than directly benchmarking religious concepts, theology, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
